'''Cal-Seti''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and was several [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] from [[N'zoth]]. It was at the intersection of the [[Agricultural Circuit]] and the [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]].

The capital, [[Ramsees Hed]], was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] docking facility. It was [[Mission to Cal-Seti|infiltrated]] by [[Kyle Katarn]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] reported that the [[Black Fleet]] had been destroyed near Cal-Seti, but in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], it was discovered that the fleet had actually been captured at N'zoth.
